svg.text: Hold Projection with a combat manipulation selected and the blood stays out as a strand. Its form decides how you fight.
docs/core_loop · proposal, nothing approved · design illustration, not in-game art
Sweep it. The tip does the work.
Hold it steady. Pressure builds, then
Close in. A wide cone, a heavy state.
Lead the target. The ring grows, then
Mark one creature for the draw.
Blood drains while you hold it. Let go and
Each form sets how fast you can walk with it
Left click forces the form's accent now: the
crack, the eruption, the brand. It costs
Tempered, the accent lands in full and sets
its school's state. Dry, it lands softer.
